rows.text: when bits 2 to 17 of dword `[rcx]` are not all zero (`test 0x3fffc`), loops an index from 0 while it is below the count (dword `[rcx]` >> 2) AND 0xFFFF and, for each pointer in the qword array at qword `rcx+0x10`, replaces bit 0 of dword `+8` of the pointed-to object with bit 0 of `edx`; otherwise returns without writing

notes: 00393190: the zero-count guard (test of dword [rcx] with 0x3fffc, jbe) masks exactly the bits that the loop bound (shr 2, movzx ax) keeps, so the loop runs (dword [rcx] >> 2) AND 0xFFFF times.
